in_hebrew.name: Bloom
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו To Blossom, Grow
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Bloom הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'Anemone', which means 'resurrection'. The name Bloom symbolizes new beginnings, growth, and renewal. In Christianity, the name is often associated with the resurrection of Jesus and the blossoming of faith.
